AdminOrders.title: Orders
AdminOrders.subtitle: Order lifecycle, allowed status transitions and documented manual payments.
AdminOrders.statusHelp: Only transitions allowed by the order state machine are offered. An order can never be set to Paid manually: it becomes Paid only through a verified card payment or a documented manual payment.
AdminOrders.manualWarning: Use only for a bank transfer you have verified on the bank account. The animal becomes SOLD, the order PAID and the customer is notified. This is permanently recorded in the audit log.
AdminOrders.noTransition: No further status change is allowed from this status.
AdminOrders.statusTransitionError: This status change is not allowed or the order changed meanwhile. Reload and try again.
